definitions.rising: Heat履歴2点以上・6時間以上のspanが揃った記事を対象に、直近24時間のHeat上昇率で算出。

latest.summary: Regions Targeted: South Asia Related Families: BITTER APT Related Threat Actors: PapRAT, WmRAT Executive Summary The suspected South Asian cyberespionage group BITTER has been linked to a campaign targeting organizations in South Asia through three infection chains that combine legitimate Windows utilities, malicious shortcuts, and custom remote access malware. PapRAT, a remote access trojan (RAT) developed in C++ and Rust, is capable of executing commands, transferring files, capturing screenshots, and maintaining attacker access. The campaign demonstrates how threat actors can blend native Windows functionality with custom implants to evade conventional detection and support persistent espionage operations.

hottest.summary: On 12 November 2026, the Cloud Software Group published security bulletins for its Citrix products addressing 28 memory flaws in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway. One of these vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-120868, affects every deployment, including those using the default configuration. The vendor bulletin describes the impact as unpredictable behaviour and denial of service. Citrix reports no exploitation, and no public proof-of-concept has been confirmed. CERT-EU strongly recommends upgrading all customer-managed NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway appliances to the fixed releases. Internet-facing Gateway and AAA appliances should be upgraded first.

persistent_hot.summary: OpenEMR バージョン 8.5.0 未満には、認証された SQL インジェクションの脆弱性が Syndromic Surveillance モジュールに存在します。この脆弱性により、Clinician レベルの権限を持つユーザーは、form_icd_codes[] の POST パラメータに細工された値を syndromicsurveillance/index エンドポイントに送信することで、任意のデータベース内容を読み取りおよび変更することが可能になります。攻撃者は、引用符なしの数値 IN() 句や UNION DISTINCT SELECT 文を 16 進数でエンコードされたリテラルを使用して注入し、MySQL の extractvalue() を悪用したエラーに基づく bcrypt パスワードハッシュの情報漏洩や、パスワードをリセットする積み重ねクエリの実行を行い、最終的に完全な管理者アカウントを乗っ取ることができます。
